description: This file contains helper functions for testing a parallel checkout process, including configuration, execution, and verification steps.

methods.name: set_checkout_config
methods.description: Sets the checkout configuration by specifying the number of workers and the threshold for parallelism.

methods.name: test_checkout_workers
methods.description: Runs a command with a specified number of expected checkout workers and verifies the number of actual workers used.

methods.name: verify_checkout
methods.description: Verifies that the working directory and index are correctly created and up to date.
